Wiring recommendations for a follow-up post-initialization task (NOT implemented here per constraints): (1) lefthook.yml with commit-msg hook running commitlint via bunx --bun and pre-commit Markdown lint; (2) justfile owning all quality-gate targets (check/fmt/lint) so linters are never invoked by name, pinned tool versions live only there; (3) CI workflow minimizing token permissions (contents: read), pinned action SHAs, no publishing from untrusted pull requests. These proposals follow the workspace toolchain policy and the security rules for generated workflows.
